function gL({ api: e, install: t, publish: n, path: a = "/api/admin/base-map/atlas", decode: o = (r) => createImageBitmap(r) }) {
  let r = null, s = "spring", i = null, c = 0, l = null;
  async function d() {
    if (!r) return;
    const u = r.editorAssets?.seasonAtlases?.[s];
    if (!u || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(u.sha256) || !Number.isSafeInteger(u.byteLength) || u.byteLength < 1 || u.byteLength > 4 * 1024 * 1024) {
      n({ atlasError: "圖集描述無效", atlasLoading: !1 });
      return;
    }
    const b = s + ":" + u.sha256;
    if (i === b) return;
    i = b;
    const m = ++c, v = s;
    t(null), l?.close(), l = null, n({ atlasLoading: !0, atlasError: "", season: s });
    try {
      const f = await e(a + "?season=" + v, void 0, { binary: !0, maxBytes: u.byteLength, feedback: "local" });
      if (m !== c) return;
      if (f.bytes.length !== u.byteLength || f.sha256 !== u.sha256) throw new Error("圖集長度或摘要不符");
      const g = Array.from(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", f.bytes)), (w) => w.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
      if (m !== c) return;
      if (g !== u.sha256) throw new Error("圖集內容校驗失敗");
      const h = await o(new Blob([f.bytes], { type: "image/png" }));
      if (m !== c) {
        h.close();
        return;
      }
      if (h.width !== 256 || h.height !== 256)
        throw h.close(), new Error("圖集尺寸無效");
      l = h, t(l);
    } catch (f) {
      m === c && (i = null, n({ atlasError: f.message }));
    } finally {
      m === c && n({ atlasLoading: !1 });
    }
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    setSource(u) {
      if (r = u, r) return d();
      c++, i = null, t(null), l?.close(), l = null, n({ atlasLoading: !1, atlasError: "", season: s });
    },
    setSeason(u) {
      if (!["spring", "summer", "autumn", "winter"].includes(u)) throw new Error("季節無效");
      return s = u, d();
    },
    retry: d
  });
}
